description: This script automates the process of rolling the BoringSSL third-party source code in Chromium's build system, updating dependencies, generating build files, and managing version control commits.

methods.name: IsPristine
methods.description: Checks if a git repository has uncommitted changes.

methods.name: RevParse
methods.description: Resolves a git revision string to a commit hash.

methods.name: UpdateDEPS
methods.description: Replaces old hash references with new hash in DEPS file.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs between two revisions.

methods.name: FormatCommit
methods.description: Formats a commit into a single-line summary.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the rolling process.
